2.note: chat.sendMessage with schema-validated customFields {type, card} + an attachment for Rocket.Chat's own UI; chat.update as the message author (only members can edit in a private group); stream-room-messages delivers the edit

5.note: Auto-Translate (Google/Microsoft/DeepL paid/LibreTranslate) per user per room; not run: no provider key (Rocket.Chat refuses DeepL free keys)
